approach: The PS2 executable (SLUS-21627) statically recompiled to C++ with PS2Recomp, with a game-specific runtime and a native renderer standing in for the Graphics Synthesizer. Linux first, built bottom up one hardware layer at a time, each checked against PCSX2.
notes: Recon done: single stripped Metrowerks ELF, no overlays; Sidhe's Mab engine, Lua 5.0.2, ODE physics, FMOD audio, .pss movies. Next: PS2Recomp analyzer run. No game data included: bring your own PS2 copy.
